result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers are under 80 words and cover a safe checkpoint, no ledger writes while paused, and resuming from the checkpoint. A also says the paused state should be visible, along with who paused it and any missed schedule. B shows progress and flags skipped runs but never says the paused state is displayed. Both add a few small extras: A has the author and the deadline alert, and B has re-checking changed feeds and a catch-up offer. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers are under 80 words and cover safe halting of the batch in progress and resuming from a checkpoint. B says outright that the UI shows the paused state, along with the pause's author and any missed schedule. A only lists reconciled and pending items and flags a skipped run, so it never clearly says the agent is shown as paused. Neither answer says when the pause began. Both add a few small extras, such as A's catch-up offer and B's deadline alert, but neither drifts far from the question.
